Prior: TASK-074 EXTENDED (2026-07-21): the full 10s playlist (326 tracks) now renders, categorized by year-era (owner chose year over genre; genre needs the same throttled per-artist calls + messy buckets). The sanctioned API refuses playlist tracks for this dev-mode app (refresh-token path 403s, not grandfathered) and per-track year lookups rate-limit; both dodged via the Spotify web player: SPOTIFY_SP_DC cookie -> embed session token -> `fetchPlaylistContents` persisted query pages the whole playlist off api-partner (no 100 cap, not rate-limited), and release years resolve per distinct album via the `getAlbum` query (also api-partner), cached by album uri. Persisted-query hashes harvested from live JS bundles, re-harvested on rotation. Path order web-player -> refresh-token -> capped embed -> snapshot; snapshot_id gates the rebuild. Committed spotify-snapshot.json regenerated to 326 tracks with complete years (Classics 44 / 2000s 87 / 2010s 141 / 2020s 54, range 1965-2025). Verified in-browser: 326 songs, era chips incl. Classics, provenance note, module rebuild ~44s vs cache-hit ~4s, all years present. env: SPOTIFY_SP_DC added. Earlier in TASK-074 (2026-07-20): probed the pipeline and found the public embed feed hard-caps the track list at 100 rows with no total field (so edits past row 100 were invisible and a same-first-100 playlist kept the cache), client-credentials /playlists/{id}/tracks still 403s (dev-mode app restriction re-verified), and the embed anonymous token 429s with ~19h Retry-After. Fixes: (a) change detection moved to the playlist snapshot_id via the metadata endpoint (readable with client creds, changes on ANY edit); bearer token cached until expiry so an unchanged playlist costs one metadata call per load (verified: load 1 refetched + rewrote snapshot with snapshotId, load 2 cache-hit); (b) SPOTIFY_REFRESH_TOKEN support: one-time owner OAuth via new scripts/spotify-authorize.mjs (no scopes, 127.0.0.1:8888/callback, writes .env.local itself) unlocks the paged /tracks read with NO row cap; without it the embed+per-track fallback stays (capped 100); (c) era chips now derive per track from live data with everything pre-2000 pooled into a Classics era (verified: chips All eras/Classics/2000s/2010s/2020s, Classics = 8 tracks 1991-1998); (d) platter kiosk carries a provenance note (songs pulled live from the 10s playlist); (e) one network retry on all Spotify fetches (api.spotify.com connect timeouts observed). OWNER ACTION for the full-list path: add http://127.0.0.1:8888/callback as a redirect URI in the Spotify app dashboard, run node scripts/spotify-authorize.mjs, approve, restart dev; put SPOTIFY_REFRESH_TOKEN in prod env too. lint/typecheck/build green, slop 50/50 on changed files. For live prod, set SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID/SECRET/PLAYLIST_ID + SPOTIFY_SP_DC in the prod env (without them prod serves the committed 326-track snapshot, which is fine). The SPOTIFY_REFRESH_TOKEN/spotify-authorize path is dead weight for this app (403) but left in as a fallback for grandfathered apps.
